name: Ugro Capital Ltd
title: Ugro Capital Ltd - 511742 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Ugro is shrinking its high-volume prime DSA book (~15-20% run-down a year) to swap into higher-yield branch LAP and embedded finance; AUM flat, opex cut to INR 490-500 cr, FY27 a transition year with no ROA guidance.

triggers.label: Opex INR 750 cr → INR 490 cr+
triggers.quote: This will reduce to INR 490 crores plus in FY27.

triggers.label: Cost of borrowings 10.16%, down 45 bps YoY
triggers.quote: Our cost of borrowings came down to 10.16%; this is for the fifth consecutive quarterly improvement

triggers.label: Prime run-down 15-20% a year
triggers.quote: Third run down Prime Intermediated portfolio at 15% to 20% annually.

triggers.label: Credit cost 1.9% of avg AUM
triggers.quote: Credit cost was at INR 72 crores, 1.9% of average AUM annualized

red_flags.label: Co-lending income volatility; ~25% of total income
red_flags.quote: our co-lending income, which is currently 25% of our total income

red_flags.label: Unsecured embedded GNPA 1.7% vs 4-4.5% design
red_flags.quote: The GNPAs are 1.7%. So we are quite comfortable up to 4% - 4.5%.

evasions.topic: Co-lending: why exit when previously championed
evasions.quote: we are still very gung -ho about co-lending.

evasions.topic: RBI capital adequacy vs net worth gap amount
evasions.quote: It's very difficult to, so the way to simplest term, you should think of this way.
